name: Do I need a rideshare injury lawyer if the rideshare company's insurance contacts me?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a rideshare injury lawyer if the rideshare company's insurance contacts me?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is highly advisable to consult with a rideshare injury lawyer before speaking to any insurance company, including the rideshare company's insurer. Insurance adjusters are trained to minimize payouts, and anything you say can be used against you. A lawyer can protect your rights, handle all communications with insurance companies, ensure accurate information is conveyed, and negotiate on your behalf to achieve a fair settlement that fully covers your damages, including medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, consult a lawyer before speaking with any insurance company. They protect your rights, handle communications, and negotiate for fair compensation.
